response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (You start to question your reasons for employing a Blubberbeast...)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (Was it out of curiosity? Or were you trying to show Navia something different?)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (Whatever the reason... you can't deny that the Blubberbeast is doing a good job. It's probably best to let it get on with its work.)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (Were it not for the Blubberbeast's consummate professionalism, it seems to you that many of the guests to the Mellow Manor might not have purchased tickets at all...)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (In fact, based on this performance, you really should be considering giving the Blubberbeast a raise.)

response.speaker: King of Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
King of Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
response.text: Blub... blub blub! Blub blub blub! Blub, blub... blub!

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (You casually imitate the Blubberbeast's call, but the creature seems to misunderstand your intent. Believing you to be talking to it in its own language, a wave of excitement washes over the Blubberbeast...)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (Despite its most enthusiastic salutations, you are unable to comprehend its meaning...)

response.speaker: Observe the Blubberbeast
response.text: (You find yourself seriously considering hiring an animal whisperer to teach you how to communicate with certain animals...)

choices.text: Good Blubberbeast! After work, I'll reward you with a grilled fish!
